description: Defines the scheduler_event_logger class with various event structures and logging methods for scheduler events in a 5G/NR context.

classes.name: scheduler_event_logger
classes.description: Logger class for various scheduler events, supporting event enqueueing and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Triggers the logging of accumulated events if enabled.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues an event for logging, forwarding the event object.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if logging mode is enabled.
